lock.mandatory_joint_freeze: Both fresh artifact sets were complete before this lock was written; neither seed had been evaluated on Liu.
lock.next_step: Commit and push this joint lock before the one-command two-seed Liu evaluation.

claim_boundary: This is a blind two-fresh-backbone confirmation of the exact frozen v2.4 mechanism and four-link contract. Passing can promote P_T/L_T plus differential evidence admission into the working main computational model across discovery, characterized-development, and fresh-confirmation networks. It cannot establish a statistical network-population prevalence, uniquely identify the human evidence transform, prove biological memory stores, or solve the separate excessive nonlearned symbolic-distance slope.

registered_rules.all_links_confirm: Promote P_T/L_T plus differential evidence admission into the working main computational model while retaining exact scope and remaining negatives.
registered_rules.competence_or_integrity_failure: The affected seed is non-interpretable; repair execution under the unchanged contract without replacement or scientific changes.
registered_rules.heterogeneous_or_unresolved: If a link passes in only one fresh seed, label it heterogeneous_or_unresolved; do not pool participants, replace a seed, change a threshold, or average into a pass.
registered_rules.link_confirmation: A link confirms only if its complete within-seed rule passes independently in both fresh seeds 2104 and 2105.
registered_rules.valid_failure: If omitted rescue fails in both fresh seeds under intact competence, reject cross-network confirmation of the simple lower-local-threshold account and revisit the subject evidence model without modifying frozen v2.4.
registered_rules.valid_local_only_globalization: Reject the local-direct interpretation if P-off restores nonlearned or remote inference.
registered_rules.valid_omitted_rescue_without_specificity: Reject the differential-routing interpretation if rescue occurs without matched evidence/query specificity.
registered_rules.valid_rescue_with_retained_harm: Reject this admission rule as a main model if retained noninferiority fails, even if omitted cells improve.

registered_rules.evidence_and_query_specificity: Within each seed, matched candidate beats evidence shuffle on omitted exact probability and omitted direct causal correctness and beats query shuffle on omitted direct causal correctness; all three paired lower bounds exceed zero.
registered_rules.local_only_nontransitive_access: Within each seed under P-off, omitted exact probability lower bound exceeds 0.50, candidate-minus-shared omitted exact lower bound exceeds zero, sampled nonlearned accuracy upper bound is at most 0.55, P-off all-source remote minus 0.25 times shared-intact all-source remote upper bound is below zero, and local-off preserves every global competence gate.
registered_rules.omitted_direct_fidelity_rescue: Within each seed, both participant-bootstrap lower bounds for omitted candidate-minus-shared exact probability and omitted candidate-minus-shared direct causal correctness exceed zero.
registered_rules.retained_fidelity_preservation: Within each seed, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for retained candidate-minus-shared exact probability is at least -0.005 and retained own-write identity passes within 1e-7.

compiler_contract.backbone_training: torch.compile(net, fullgraph=True) with PyTorch default mode through train_meta_model
compiler_contract.liu_replay: frozen eager evaluation with no parameter update

lock.immutability: Any execution repair after artifact generation begins requires a superseding implementation lock naming the defect; seeds, training, gain adaptation, admission equation, controls, maps, estimands, thresholds, and outcome rules remain unchanged.
lock.next_lock: After both final-step backbones and both final-step generic gains exist, create and push benchmarks/dual_evidence_access_confirmation_v2_4.artifact_lock.json before any Liu evaluation.

reuse_contract.liu_evaluation: The confirmation runner calls the repair1-locked v2.4 evaluate_seed and cross_seed_decision functions for all seven conditions and four primary links.
reuse_contract.path_binding: A scoped context binds only the fresh specification and output root required by the reused v2.4 function and restores both module constants afterward.
reuse_contract.training_and_gain: The confirmation runner calls the frozen v2.3 train_backbone, adapt_gain, seed_specification, and artifact validation primitives without changing their equations or compiler settings.

registered_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and the dual-intact H>A direct-correctness bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
registered_rules.aggregate_local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.global_branch_preservation: Original-v1/local-off exactly reproduces v1, passes every qualification_v2 intervention and query-order rule, retains positive query-binding contrasts, and retains an expected-rank-minus-MAP bootstrap lower bound above zero.
registered_rules.global_off_remote_collapse: The participant-bootstrap upper bound for global-P-off/local-intact remote absolute influence minus 0.25 times original-v1 remote absolute influence is below zero.
registered_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Dual-intact remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original-v1.
registered_rules.learned_accuracy_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 learned accuracy exceeds zero.
registered_rules.local_direct_specificity: For the natural local branch, the participant-bootstrap lower bound of mean absolute direct influence minus three times mean absolute disjoint remote influence exceeds zero.
registered_rules.local_only_direct_memory: Under global-P-off/local-intact, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for learned accuracy exceeds 0.55, the upper bound for nonlearned accuracy is at most 0.60, and the paired lower bound for learned minus nonlearned accuracy exceeds 0.10.
registered_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Dual-intact nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and its paired participant-bootstrap lower bound relative to original-v1 is no smaller than -0.02.
registered_rules.query_address_specificity: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus local-query-key-shuffle retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
